title: Young Woman Posing by Vintage Car, 1955 Suburban B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A 1955 square black and white snapshot capturing a young woman standing confidently with one hand on her hip beside a vintage American automobile parked on a suburban residential street. She wears a light-colored short-sleeved top with high-waisted shorts and saddle-style shoes, embodying mid-century summer casual fashion. In the background are typical post-WWII suburban single-family homes and lawns. The right margin features a photo processing date stamp reading 'JUN • 55'.
